chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Maḥbūb, from ʿAbbād ibn Ṣuhayb, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Allah, Mighty and Majestic, says: “When the one who knows Me disobeys Me, I set over him one who does not know Me.”

key_terms.اللَّهُ: Allah, the Divine speaker in the hadith
key_terms.سَلَّطْتُ: I set in power over; I cause to dominate or prevail over
key_terms.عَرَفَنِي: knows Me; possesses recognition of Allah
key_terms.عَزَّ وَجَلَّ: Mighty and Majestic; an honorific expressing Allah’s exaltedness
key_terms.عَصَانِي: disobeys Me; rebellion against Allah despite obligation
key_terms.لَا يَعْرِفُنِي: does not know Me; lacks recognition of Allah

ai.seo_question: What happens when a person who knows Allah still disobeys Him?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that maʿrifah of Allah does not excuse disobedience; rather, knowingly disobeying Him brings punishment. One form of that punishment is that Allah allows such a person to fall under the domination of those who do not recognize Him.
